messages.author: be6024b785b6a9c1
messages.subject: legend title issue
parts:
A trivial bug

This fails to change the label:
qplot(carat, price, data=diamonds[1:100,], color=color)+labs(color="My
Own Color")

This works fine
qplot(carat, price, data=diamonds[1:100,], color=color)
+labs(colour="My Own Color")

messages.author: 99a1cfc66539313c
messages.subject: Re: legend title issue
parts:
As far as I know, Hadley started to change the use of "color" to
"colour". So, I suspect the "correct" code should be:

qplot(carat, price, data=diamonds[1:100,], colour=color)

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: legend title issue
parts:
Hi:

Actually, after a lot of hectoring by those Americans, Hadley's been trying to eliminate those colour/color gotchas. He started out using colour in the package and has been browbeaten with requests to support both spellings uniformly throughout the code. You know how those Americans are...

Dennis (an American :)
